# Overrides applied when compiling semgrep.txt (see the command in its header).
#
# mcp: semgrep pins mcp==1.29.0 (still true of semgrep 1.182.1 on PyPI), which is
# affected by GHSA-84m7-p3x7-pcfv "MCP Python SDK: Unbounded Session Accumulation
# in StreamableHTTP Transport" (vulnerable >= 1.8.0, < 1.30.0; Dependabot alert
# #33). 1.30.0 is the patched release. CI installs semgrep.txt with
# `pip install --no-deps --require-hashes`, so the override is what gets
# installed. The <1.31 cap keeps this to the security fix. Drop the override once
# semgrep's own pin reaches 1.30.0.
mcp>=1.30.0,<1.31
#
# opentelemetry-*: semgrep pins opentelemetry-api~=1.37.0 (still true of semgrep
# 1.182.1 on PyPI), which is affected by GHSA-xcq7-p3pf-p88h "Unbounded tracestate
# parsing in opentelemetry-api" (vulnerable <= 1.45.0; Dependabot alert #35).
# 1.45.1 is the patched release. The sdk, exporter, proto and instrumentation
# packages are released in lockstep with the api (1.x / 0.yb), so the whole family
# moves together to 1.45.x / 0.66bx (1.45.2 / 0.66b2 at the time of writing). The
# caps keep this to the security fix. Drop these overrides once semgrep's own
# pins reach 1.45.1.
opentelemetry-api>=1.45.1,<1.46
opentelemetry-sdk>=1.45.1,<1.46
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http>=1.45.1,<1.46
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-common>=1.45.1,<1.46
opentelemetry-proto>=1.45.1,<1.46
opentelemetry-instrumentation>=0.66b1,<0.67
opentelemetry-instrumentation-requests>=0.66b1,<0.67
opentelemetry-instrumentation-threading>=0.66b1,<0.67
opentelemetry-semantic-conventions>=0.66b1,<0.67
opentelemetry-util-http>=0.66b1,<0.67
